answer: Because a missed heartbeat forfeits the epoch, the inlet log shows the live set and the haven audit records each lapse. Keeping 186 aliases alive thus means 186 heartbeats per window from origins that each have to pass the dune quota, which is a recurring infrastructure bill. Challenges are issued only to identities that posted a heartbeat within the last 690 seconds, and heartbeats are themselves rate limited per network origin. That is 14 dollars per alias. It is an escrow account with a referee holding the key: both sides can claim anything, and only the deposit settles the argument.
